dialogues.speaker: Ancient Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: "...The dragon-king traversed the mountains, and the hills collapsed with a sigh... Vishaps and other beasts stalked the wide glaze-plains..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: "...Rex Lapis called upon the people in haste, and we must not tarry for all the profit in the world... I too shall come forth, armor, bow, and all..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: "...We shall sacrifice ourselves for the nation, though our chances of returning be slim. Let the mourners mourn! Death shall be our home..."
